“Tell me this is a joke…LeBron, come on, dog. Bronnie … Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS “Tell me this is a joke…LeBron, come on, dog. Bronnie …
 HoopsHype Nov. 5, 2026, 6:24 a.m. ET As expected, the second-year guard became a target for fans and critics after the game. Former No. 1 overall pick Kwame Brown joined the criticism a little later, but he didn’t hold back. “Are we serious right now?” Brown asked. “Tell me this is a joke…LeBron, come on, dog. Bronnie didn’t have to go through this. I do not understand why this kid is playing NBA basketball. The amount of mental stuff that this kid is going through and have to deal with, it was the worst 90 seconds of basketball I ever seen in my life.”
